comparison.objective: Extend a utility blade, slit a carton seam without product damage, then retract it; candidate adjusts and validates a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Angle-controlled cutting over a long path and slider actuation versus hex-key insertion, counterholding, fine rotation and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Complete tape cut, no product/carton damage and blade retracted versus safe repeated stops without bottoming or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Shared tool handling is generic; cutting-depth control is meaningfully different from mechanical tuning. Candidate lacks numeric rebound, overload, drift and tightening limits.
